name: blixel
description: Rooms, meeting chat, window sharing, transcripts, hooks and agent handoffs through the blixel CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Rooms, meeting chat, transcripts, hooks and handoffs
interface.longDescription: Uses the blixel CLI to create rooms and get their invite links, see who is in a room, read, follow and post to the current meeting's chat, share windows into it, search, read, export or follow transcripts recorded on this Mac, and set up hooks that run a command when something happens in Blixel. It also connects this session to the call, so people in it can hand it spoken or typed requests.
